newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary o/n rates end steady at 20.5/20.75 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungary o/n rates end steady at 20.5/20.75 pct.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interest rates finished unchanged on Monday, traders said.
The overnight rates closed at 20.5/20.75 percent, compared with Friday's closing of 20.625 percent.

Traders said the market was balanced but less liquid as the National Bank of Hungary's (NBH) one-week reverse repo facility of 20.75 percent was attractive to lenders at the current market interest rate levels, while the borrowing side was weak.
They added that funds flowed into reverse repo deals and market players had some expectations of repo rate cuts, but these remained moderate.
